description: Held the linen, spared him the crust, and set the saucer by the inkhorn.
name: Alse Pinder

description: Named the villain, refused the hot drawing, and set the price and the hour.
name: Barnaby Yaxley

description: Bound the bran, kept Tuesday and twelve pence, and noted that he had gone himself.
name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

description: Held the poultice, repeated the hour and the price, and left the sheet alone.
name: William Shakespeare
